cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook highlights Martinez's Olympic silver medal, long amateur résumé and seven knockouts in seven professional wins. The opposing case is substantial: Olascuaga is the proven WBO champion, Martinez is 35 with only seven professional bouts, and official scale readings were not reliably available at cutoff. The direct DraftKings pair of Martinez +450 and Olascuaga −700 normalizes Martinez near 17.2%, or roughly +481 fair, so +450 is short; the aggregator-only FanDuel +490 is not executable confirmation and still lacks enough cushion for promotion.
cards.movement: Aggregate best price widened from +470 at tracking open to +490, while current books range from roughly +350 to +490 and direct DraftKings is +450. The disagreement rewards patience rather than chasing.
